name: ANSI/IEEE Maximum-current monitoring relay form
summary: IEEE-library form of maximum-current monitoring relay: a maximum-current relay changes its output when the measured current meets a configured high-current condition.
description: This reference locates maximum-current monitoring relay in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented current protection relays family. A maximum-current relay changes its output when the measured current meets a configured high-current condition. Its schematic separates measurement, auxiliary power and relay outputs. The public library uses HCR1F25 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace the measured quantity or initiating control signal separately from the output contacts. The device tag links the sensing or operating element to the controlled circuit; settings, reset behaviour and the actual terminal arrangement belong in the selected equipment documentation.

Determine whether the input is direct current, a CT secondary or a conditioned signal. A maximum-current monitoring element is not a complete feeder protection scheme by itself. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
